verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound webhooks for subscribing to Hightouch events. Sync alerts ("Get notified when a run fails") are not described as HTTP callbacks. The REST API, MCP server, and custom destinations are adjacent features rather than event subscriptions. Webhooks are a fair axis for a SaaS data platform, so absence of evidence yields none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
